selection.edition: international Browser Use Cloud API v4 with v3 billing
selection.ownership: Browser Use is a Y Combinator W25 company founded by Magnus Müller and Gregor Žunič (ETH Zurich). YC lists San Francisco; PyPI credits Zurich and San Francisco. The reviewed edition is the public Cloud API at api.browser-use.com/api/v3, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Browser Use Cloud API v4 at https://api.browser-use.com/api/v4 plus v3 GET /billing/account. Composio BROWSER_USE tools map onto v4 runs, conversation sessions, managed browsers, profiles, workspaces, and integrations. GET /billing/account remains the pinned credential validator used as healthcheck.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Browser Use Cloud billing and session reads provide cheap authenticated inventory without billed session creation.
exception.incident: 24 March 2026 attackers published malicious litellm 1.82.7/1.82.8 on PyPI. Browser Use CLI install.sh depended on litellm>=1.82.2, so CLI installs in that window received credential-harvesting malware. This is an open-source CLI supply-chain incident, not a documented compromise of api.browser-use.com customer API keys. CVE-2025-47241 (URL parsing in the OSS library before 0.1.45) was patched.
exception.remediation: PyPI removed the malicious litellm versions. Browser Use removed litellm from core dependencies (April–May 2026) and published cleanup guidance. CVE-2025-47241 was fixed in 0.1.45.
exception.residualRisk: Historical CLI-install supply-chain residual for users who installed during the window and did not rotate credentials. Live Cloud API authentication unverified.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /billing/account, the cheap authenticated billing read used by the pinned validator. POST /sessions is omitted as a billed write.

Native omits the upstream user-agent and Content-Type on GET. Pinned source always sends Content-Type application/json; official GET examples send only X-Browser-Use-API-Key. skipDnsValidation is an upstream SDK concern; native pins api.browser-use.com.
v4 browsers/profiles/workspaces proxy routing is omitted; this edition is Cloud API v3 only.

billing.account.get.title: Get billing account
billing.account.get.description: Get Browser Use Cloud account billing and plan information.

browsers.create.title: Create browser session
browsers.create.description: Launch a paid managed browser for direct CDP control; time is prepaid and unused time is refunded when the browser is stopped.

browsers.downloads.list.title: List browser downloads
browsers.downloads.list.description: List one page of files downloaded by a managed browser, optionally including presigned URLs that expire after 15 minutes.

browsers.get.title: Get browser session
browsers.get.description: Get a managed browser's status, control URLs, costs, metadata, and recording state.

browsers.list.title: List browser sessions
browsers.list.description: List managed browser sessions with status, metadata, and agent-session filters, one page at a time.

browsers.stop.title: Stop browser session
browsers.stop.description: Stop a managed browser session and refund unused prepaid time subject to the one-minute minimum charge.

extensions.get.title: Get extension
extensions.get.description: Get an uploaded extension by its ID.

extensions.list.title: List extensions
extensions.list.description: List the extensions uploaded to this project.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Browser Use API key by reading account billing.

integrations.categories.list.title: List integration categories
integrations.categories.list.description: List the category names used to organize Browser Use integration providers.

integrations.disconnect.title: Disconnect integration
integrations.disconnect.description: Disconnect a downstream provider from the Browser Use project, revoking its availability to future runs.

integrations.list.title: List integrations
integrations.list.description: Search Browser Use integration providers and filter by popularity or project connection status, one page at a time.

integrations.status.get.title: Get integration status
integrations.status.get.description: Check whether one downstream integration provider is connected to the Browser Use project.

paymentMethods.list.title: List run payment methods
paymentMethods.list.description: Return AgentCard wallets that browser runs can use for payments.

profiles.create.title: Create browser profile
profiles.create.description: Create a persistent browser profile for reusable cookies and browser state.

profiles.delete.title: Delete browser profile
profiles.delete.description: Permanently delete a persistent browser profile and its configuration.

profiles.get.title: Get browser profile
profiles.get.description: Get one persistent browser profile's metadata and observed cookie domains.

profiles.list.title: List browser profiles
profiles.list.description: List or search persistent browser profiles one page at a time.

profiles.update.title: Update browser profile
profiles.update.description: Update a persistent browser profile's name, user identifier, or both.

runs.attachments.list.title: List run attachments
runs.attachments.list.description: List metadata for the upload files attached to a run.

runs.cancel.title: Cancel run
runs.cancel.description: Idempotently cancel an in-flight browser-agent run.

runs.create.title: Start browser run
runs.create.description: Start an asynchronous hosted browser-agent task that may make irreversible changes on external sites and consume project credits.

runs.events.list.title: List run events
runs.events.list.description: Read one page of a run's execution events incrementally, with optional event output payloads.

runs.get.title: Get run
runs.get.description: Get a run's full result and usage.

runs.list.title: List runs
runs.list.description: List browser-agent runs, optionally restricted to one conversation session, one page at a time.

runs.status.get.title: Get run status
runs.status.get.description: Read a run's lightweight indexed status for caller-controlled polling.

sessions.cost.get.title: Get session cost
sessions.cost.get.description: Everything this session has cost so far, split by source.

sessions.delete.title: Delete session
sessions.delete.description: Soft-delete a conversation session and cancel its active run and pending messages.

sessions.feedback.get.title: Get session feedback
sessions.feedback.get.description: Get all feedback votes recorded for a conversation session.

sessions.feedback.set.title: Set session feedback
sessions.feedback.set.description: Set or replace feedback for one session chat item.

sessions.get.title: Get session
sessions.get.description: Get one conversation session's latest-run summary and busy or idle status.

sessions.list.title: List sessions
sessions.list.description: List conversation sessions with each session's latest run and busy or idle status, one page at a time.

sessions.queue.cancel.title: Cancel queued message
sessions.queue.cancel.description: Cancel a queued session message while it is still pending.

sessions.queue.create.title: Queue session message
sessions.queue.create.description: Queue a follow-up for a conversation session, optionally interrupting its active run.

sessions.queue.get.title: Get queued message
sessions.queue.get.description: Get one queued session message, including its terminal handoff state.

sessions.queue.list.title: List session queue
sessions.queue.list.description: List pending and recently delivered messages for a conversation session.

sessions.share.get.title: Get session share
sessions.share.get.description: Get a session's current or inactive public share-link state without changing its exposure.

sessions.share.set.title: Set session sharing
sessions.share.set.description: Enable or disable a session's stable public share link via PUT /sessions/{sessionId}/share.

stripeLink.get.title: Get Stripe Link status
stripeLink.get.description: The project's active Stripe Link wallet connection, if any.

workspaces.archive.title: Archive workspace
workspaces.archive.description: Archive a workspace so it is no longer readable through the workspace API.

workspaces.create.title: Create workspace
workspaces.create.description: Create an empty workspace for browser-run input files and outputs.

workspaces.files.delete.title: Delete workspace file
workspaces.files.delete.description: Permanently delete one exact relative file path from a workspace.

workspaces.files.list.title: List workspace files
workspaces.files.list.description: List one page of files in a workspace by path prefix, optionally including temporary download URLs.

workspaces.size.get.title: Get workspace size
workspaces.size.get.description: Return current storage usage and the plan-specific workspace quota.
